gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: diarrhea for 3 days. Generated cc-001: diarrhea for three days. Same content.
Gold: diarrhea for 3 days. Generated hpi-001: onset approximately three days ago. Duration is captured; added frequency is extra.
Gold: diarrhea associated with abdominal pain. Generated hpi-003: patient experiences mild abdominal pain. Association with diarrhea is clear from context of HPI about diarrhea.
Gold: stools contain no mucus or blood. Generated hpi-002 explicitly states no blood or mucus.
Gold: single episode of vomiting. Generated hpi-004: one episode of vomiting. Same fact.
Gold: still able to eat and drink. Generated hpi-008: still able to drink; loss of appetite is mentioned, but ability to continue eating solid food is not clearly stated.

Gold: watery diarrhea 4–5 times/day, sometimes mixed solid and loose. Generated hpi-001 gives 4–5 times/day; hpi-002 describes watery and loose but omits the component of sometimes mixed solid and loose. Frequency and watery/loose consistency are covered; the 'mixed solid and loose' nuance is missing.
Gold: patient reports no fever. Generated hpi-006: patient is uncertain but suspects a possible low-grade fever. This opposes the clear denial of fever in Gold.
Gold: loss of appetite. Generated hpi-005: mild loss of appetite, and hpi-009: appetite less than usual. Same core fact, with added severity descriptor.
Gold: did not eat out. Generated hpi-007: denies new/unusual food exposures or eating 'anything dodgy', which captures not eating out/unsafe food.
Gold: no foreign travel. Generated hpi-007: denies recent travel. Matches.
Gold: history of asthma. Generated pmh-001: history of asthma (ongoing). Same fact.
Gold: yellow inhaler named Lapriso. Generated med-001: yellow inhaler called 'Laxepro'. The inhaler name differs, which is a direct conflict for a medication detail.
Gold: no allergies. Generated allergy-001: no known drug allergies. Equivalent in this context.
Gold: father died of bowel cancer 10 years ago. Generated fh-002: father died of bowel cancer 10 years ago at age 62. Same fact with added age detail.
Gold: family history of hypertension. Generated fh-001: father has hypertension. This is a specific expression of family history of HTN.
Gold: no dehydration on exam. Generated facts mention no *reported* signs of dehydration (hpi-011) but there is no explicit physical exam finding. Clinical exam finding is missing.

Gold: diagnosis is gastroenteritis. Generated asm-001: acute diarrhea likely due to viral gastroenteritis; asm-002: infectious gastroenteritis in differential. Gastroenteritis as primary working diagnosis is captured.

Gold: advised soft diet starting with crackers, soups, and mash. Generated plan-001: continue soft diet (crackers, toast, boiled vegetables, mashed foods). Crackers and mashed/soft foods are covered; soups are not explicitly mentioned.
Gold: advised to drink plenty of fluids. Generated plan-004: maintain adequate oral fluid intake. Same instruction.
Gold: recommended Dioralyte oral rehydration solution. Generated plan-005: oral rehydration solutions such as Dioralyte recommended. Same core content.

Gold: may progress to mashed vegetables after initial soft foods. Generated plan-001: includes boiled vegetables and mashed foods in soft diet, but does not explicitly describe staged progression after initial foods. Progression aspect is only implicitly present.
Gold: yogurts recommended as probiotics. Generated plan-003: yoghurt with probiotics encouraged. Same fact.

Gold: if diarrhea >1 week or blood appears, stool sample will be required. Generated plan-006: seek care if diarrhea >1 week or bloody; plan-007: if red flags, stool sample may be warranted. Conditions match; explicit link stool-sample-for-these-specific-triggers is generalized to 'red flags', so linkage is less specific but conceptually present.

Gold: if >8 episodes and risk of dehydration, book appointment. Generated plan-006: threshold is 6–8 stools/day. This lowers the frequency threshold and thus contradicts the specified >8 episodes criterion.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Onset ~3 days is supported by hpi-001. The 4–5 times daily frequency aligns with hpi-006. Statement is consistent but combines elements across gold facts.
No blood or mucus is supported by hpi-003. Description of consistency as watery/loose is mostly supported by hpi-006, but omits the nuance of 'sometimes mixed solid and loose.'
Generated: possible low-grade fever. Gold hpi-007: patient reports no fever. Direct conflict.

Denies eating anything dodgy/new exposures is supported by 'did not eat out'. Denial of recent travel is supported by hpi-010. Phrase 'new or unusual food exposures' is an interpretive extension but consistent.
Gold explicitly states still eating and drinking. Generated only mentions drinking fluids; eating is not addressed. So only the drinking component is supported.

Generated: denies stool frequency >8/day. Gold gives actual frequency (4–5/day) and a follow-up rule for >8, but does not document a patient denial of >8. This is a new negative statement, not directly stated in Gold.

Generated: patient denies signs of dehydration. Gold: physical exam shows no dehydration (phys-001) but not necessarily patient report. This is an added history element distinct from the exam finding.
Gold med-001: yellow inhaler Lapriso. Generated: yellow inhaler 'Laxepro'. Different inhaler name; direct conflict.
No OTC treatment use is not mentioned in any Gold fact, so this is new information.
Adds age 62, which is not in Gold, but death from bowel cancer 10 years ago is supported.
Gold diagnosis gastroenteritis; generated specifies likely viral gastroenteritis as cause of acute diarrhea. Compatible with Gold assessment.
Differential diagnoses (infectious vs bacterial, etc.) are not listed in the Gold facts. This is extra clinical reasoning.
Food intolerance as a differential is not in Gold. New detail.
Inflammatory bowel disease as a differential is not mentioned in Gold. New detail.

Soft diet advice is supported and crackers/mash fit Gold. Avoiding dairy, eggs, fish, meat until 48 hours symptom-free is not in Gold and is an addition.
Specific rule about gradual reintroduction of meat/eggs/fish after 48 hours symptom-free is not present in Gold; Gold only mentions building on with mash and vegetables.

Gold fu-001 & fu-002: review if diarrhea >1 week or blood, and if >8 episodes due to dehydration risk. Generated uses a lower threshold of 6–8 stools/day as reason to seek care, which conflicts with the >8 episodes threshold in Gold.

Gold: if diarrhea >1 week or blood, stool sample needed. Generated: if red flags, stool sample for microbiological analysis/possible antibiotics. Concept (stool sample with red flags like blood/persistence) is consistent, but the rationale and scope (microbiology, antibiotics) are added.
No antidiarrheal medications initiated is not discussed in Gold facts, so this is new.
Self-monitoring of stool frequency/character and hydration is not mentioned in Gold; this is added management advice.
Outpatient self-management statement is not present in Gold facts.
Generic advice to review/seek care if ongoing concerns or deterioration is not explicitly stated in Gold follow-up facts, which are more specific about duration, blood, and frequency thresholds.
